description: Figure 7 illustrates the average rate at which a model attends to each input segment—context, generated response, or other—during generation. The horizontal axis, labeled “Position” (x-axis), displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 12, with tick marks at integer values. The vertical axis, labeled “Avg. rate” (y-axis), indicates the average attention rate and ranges from 0.20 to 0.70, with tick marks at 0.20 intervals. Three bar sets are presented for each position, representing “Standard”, “Cings (w/ context sup)”, and “Ours”, colored blue, purple, and green, respectively. For each position, the bars show a consistent trend: “Standard” generally has the lowest attention rate, “Cings (w/ context sup)” is intermediate, and “Ours” has the highest. For example, at position 5, “Standard” has an approximate rate of 0.35, “Cings (w/ context sup)” has an approximate rate of 0.45, and “Ours” has an approximate rate of 0.60. Error bars are included above each bar, indicating variance. The bar sets are arranged sequentially by position, and no bars are visually emphasized.
